relationships.evidence_quote: The study revealed that IL-10 alleviated radicular pain by inhibiting TNF-α/p-p65 dependent Nav1.7 up-regulation in DRG neurons.

key_findings: Nucleus pulposus implantation raised Nav1.7 and TNF-α and lowered IL-10 in DRG; intrathecal IL-10 reversed pain and Nav1.7/TNF-α/p-p65 changes.
